subject: Invoice INV-5589 — remittance split and bank proof needed
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Novagen AP <ap@novagen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice INV-5589 — remittance options and documentation ask

Hi Paula / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-5589 (attached) which was due 2029-06-10. We haven’t received confirmation of payment yet — can you share whether this will be paid by ACH, wire, or virtual card?

A couple of notes that will speed processing on our side:
- If you need split remittance (multiple Novagen legal entities), please specify the exact split percentages and the legal entity names so we can issue separate remittance advices.
- For any wire payment we need a bank confirmation letter (PDF) or a quick bank-account-attestation email from your treasury team.
- If your AP prefers ACH to one entity and wire to another, we can accommodate, but we’ll need entity tax IDs/W9s for invoicing and bookkeeping.

Options we can support:
1) Single wire (full amount) — fastest to reconcile.
2) Split rails — wire + ACH split between two legal entities (requires separate entity invoices).
3) Virtual card for full amount (we’ll accept but may charge the standard processing fee).

If you can reply with the chosen rail and attach any requested docs, we’ll mark the invoice pending and avoid rolling to collections. Happy to offer a 5-business-day extension if your treasury needs a short runway to produce the bank proof.

Attachments: INV-5589.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Paula Simmons <paula.simmons@novagen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novagen AP <ap@novagen.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-5589 — remittance options and documentation ask

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — this one is a little more complicated on our end.

Novagen is requesting a split payment across two of our entities for this invoice:
- Novagen Technologies, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — 60% of the invoice to be wired to our domestic treasury account.
- Novagen Innovations LLC (EIN: 98-7654321) — 40% to be sent via ACH from our US AP bank.

We can provide a bank-letter for the wire (draft being prepared by treasury). We also need an updated invoice split to reflect both legal entities (we can’t pay a single-entity invoice that covers both). Can Redwood issue two invoices (INV-5589-NTI and INV-5589-NI) and advise the account names to hit for each?

We’ll send the bank letter and a W9 for Novagen Innovations (we will redact the SSNs where applicable) by end of week. Wire timing looks like next Friday (6/22) for the wired portion and ACH scheduled for Monday (6/24). Will that work on your side?

— Paula
Director, AP Operations
Novagen Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice INV-5589 — split remittance request (Novagen)

Marissa / Ben — FYI. Novagen wants to split the invoice across two legal entities (60% wire, 40% ACH). They’ll provide a bank-letter and a redacted W9.

Questions for ops / finance:
- Can we generate two invoices for a single SOW/contract and apply the payment split when cash hits?
- Is there any AML/OPS reason we should insist on escrow for the wire portion until we receive the bank confirmation?
- I suggested a 5-business-day extension to avoid late fees while treasury compiles docs — happy to confirm this if you approve.

If ops can accept split rails once we have the entity invoices and W9, I’ll ask Novagen to go ahead with the wire on 6/22 and ACH on 6/24.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice INV-5589 — split remittance request (Novagen)

Karthik — we can accept split rails but need clean bookkeeping separation. Ops + Revenue recognize on legal-entity invoices only. Two quick asks before we confirm: 

1) Please have Novagen provide the redacted W9 for Novagen Innovations LLC (as they mentioned). That’s mandatory for ACH posting and tax records.
2) For the wire: ask their treasury to attach the bank-letter (signed by bank) or a bank-stamped ACH/wire verification PDF. We can accept a bank email if it originates from the bank domain.

I’d prefer NOT to require escrow if the bank-letter is valid and the invoices are split into two entity-specific documents. Once payments clear we’ll allocate to the two invoices.

I’ll approve waiving any late fee if they provide the documents and confirm the payment dates (6/22 wire / 6/24 ACH). Please push for the docs and then confirm the extension. Also see payment-ops runbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-payment-ops-runbook

— Ben
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Paula Simmons <paula.simmons@novagen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novagen AP <ap@novagen.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 15:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-5589 — remittance options and documentation ask

Karthik / team — attaching the requested docs.

Attachments (stubs):
- W9_redacted.pdf (Novagen Innovations LLC)
- BankLetter_Novagen.pdf (signed bank confirmation for wire routing)
- Partial-PO.pdf (for reference)

Wire/ACH timing confirmed: wire for Novagen Technologies on 2029-06-22 (60%). ACH for Novagen Innovations on 2029-06-24 (40%). Please issue two invoices (INV-5589-NTI and INV-5589-NI) and mark INV-5589 as split/pending.

Thanks for the extension and flexibility — we appreciate the cooperation. If you need anything else from treasury I’ll loop them in.

Best,
Paula
Director, AP Operations
Novagen Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Paula Simmons <paula.simmons@novagen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-5589 — remittance options and documentation ask

Thanks Paula — received. We’ve got the W9 and bank letter attached to the record and will generate two invoices today (INV-5589-NTI and INV-5589-NI). I’ll mark the original INV-5589 as pending/split in our billing system and waive the late fee per Ben’s approval.

Expected next steps:
- 6/22: Redwood to reconcile wire when funds are received for Novagen Technologies (60%).
- 6/24: Redwood to reconcile ACH when Novagen Innovations (40%) posts.
- I’ll send a short confirmation once both hits reconcile.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the docs — that made this pretty straightforward.

Cheers,
Karthik
Senior Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference
